facts.title: gnocchi in tomato broth
ingredients: One 28-ounce (795 grams) can whole or chopped tomatoes with juices
Small handful fresh basil leaves, plus more for garnish
2 cups (475 ml) chicken or vegetable stock
Salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
1 1/4 to 1 1/2 cups (156 to 190 grams) all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting surface
facts.yield_text: Yield: 2 1/2 to 3 cups broth and 85 to 100 gnocchi, serving 4
facts.author: Deb Perelman
